description: This file defines classes and methods for integrating with the Parallel AI search API, including request formatting, environment validation, URL construction, and response transformation into a standardized search result format.

classes.name: ParallelAISearchConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Parallel AI search API, including environment validation, URL construction, query transformation, and response parsing.

classes.name: ParallelAISearchRequest
classes.description: Data class representing the request format for Parallel AI search API, including optional parameters like objective, search queries, source policy, etc.

classes.name: _ParallelAISourcePolicy
classes.description: TypedDict defining allowed and disallowed domains for source policy in search results.

classes.name: _ParallelAISearchRequestRequired
classes.description: TypedDict indicating required fields for the search request, currently empty but used as a base class.

methods.name: ui_friendly_name
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for the search configuration, 'Parallel AI'.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates and sets up headers with API key and content type for API requests.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full API endpoint URL, appending '/v1beta/search' if necessary.

methods.name: _transform_query_to_objective
methods.description: Converts a list of strings or a single string into a single string objective.

methods.name: transform_search_request
methods.description: Transforms user query and optional parameters into the API-specific request dictionary.

methods.name: transform_search_response
methods.description: Converts the raw API response into a standardized SearchResponse object, mapping fields accordingly.
